requirements.source_anchor: G5 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Ledger Identity)
requirements.requirement: Enforce stable source-row identity: same source row -> same stable identity; distinct legitimate source rows -> distinct identities.

requirements.source_anchor: G5 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Repeated-Import Stability)
requirements.requirement: Ensure repeated uTower import of identical records is idempotent and preserves stable source identities without generating duplicate rows.

requirements.source_anchor: G5 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Preservation of Identical Rows)
requirements.requirement: Preserve distinct identities for distinct legitimate historical transactions with identical amounts/timestamps; SQLite ROWID is not assumed identity.

requirements.source_anchor: G5 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Preservation of Reliable IDs)
requirements.requirement: Preserve existing reliable transaction IDs during migration and synchronization without re-generating random identifiers.
